lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
They call me up at midnight
I come running every time
The party girl with neon eyes
The one who never says no
Champagne bottles on the counter
Laughter echoes off the walls
Another blur of strangers' faces
I won't remember tomorrow at all
[chorus]
I'm swinging high on the chandelier
Dancing 'til I can't feel a thing
Holding on tight to the crystal light
It's the only prayer that I can sing
One more night, one more high
Trying to pretend that I am free
Just the Chandelier Dancer
Running from the quiet in me
[verse]
When the lights go down and I'm alone
I feel the weight of all I've thrown away
The hollow echoes of a crowded room
Fade into the grey of light of day
I drink it down to keep the silence out
The stillness is a monster at my door
It scares me more than any fall could
So I keep wanting just a little more
[chorus]
I'm swinging high on the chandelier
Dancing 'til I can't feel a thing
Holding on tight to the crystal light
It's the only prayer that I can sing
One more night, one more high
Trying to pretend that I am free
Just the Chandelier Dancer
Running from the quiet in me
[bridge]
Tomorrow the phone will ring again
And I'll jump back into the spin
Caught in the loop of a gilded cage
Turning the page, burning the stage
[chorus]
I'm swinging high on the chandelier
Dancing 'til I can't feel a thing
Holding on tight to the crystal light
It's the only prayer that I can sing
One more night, one more high
Trying to pretend that I am free
Just the Chandelier Dancer
Running from the quiet in me
[outro]
